user.title: Hertsmere Bin Collection
user.description: Set up your bin collection sensor. The base URL and version letter are combined with the current period to build the calendar PDF link.

data.base_url: Base URL (folder that holds the calendar PDFs)

data_description.collection_day: The weekday your bins are actually collected. This is not in the PDF, so you must set it.
data_description.version: The letter at the end of the PDF filename (A or B), which identifies your collection round.
data_description.base_url: Usually leave the default. The filename is built automatically from the year and half-year.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download the calendar PDF from that URL.
error.parse_error: Downloaded the file but could not read it as a calendar PDF.
error.empty: The PDF was read but no collection weeks were found; check the version letter and URL.

abort.already_configured: This calendar and collection day is already set up.

data.name_garden: Garden waste name (shown in W2 weeks)

data_description.threshold_days: When the loaded calendar has this many days left, the integration tries to download the next one and warns you if that fails.
data_description.upcoming_days: How many days before collection the 'upcoming' attribute is set to true. 0 means only the collection day itself; 1 means also the day before; and so on.
data_description.bank_holiday_note: Hover text for the bank-holiday icon on the card.
data_description.expiry_note: Hover text for the expiry-warning icon on the card.
data_description.title_prefix: Prefix for the card title, e.g. 'Bin collection:'.
data_description.update_hours: How often to recompute the current week (hours). The PDF is only re-downloaded near expiry, not every refresh.
